result.summary: Independently re-derived, not copied from any prior agent's report. (1) FULL SUITE, FRESH RUN: `mix test` on branch feature/WF02-REQ030-20260817 (commit 29fe381) -> `Result: 461 passed (4 properties, 457 tests)`, exit code 0, 0 failures (confirmed via `MIX_TEST_EXIT=$?` capture, not inferred from absence of a 'failures' line). `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -> clean, 0 warnings. Matches TEST-RUNNER's step-04 claim (461/461) -- corroborated by my own separate execution, not trusted from the report alone. (2) TOCTOU REWORK RE-VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY, NOT TRUSTED ON TWO PRIOR PASSES: ran test/letflow/definitions/store_test.exs (the file containing the 'Regression -- activate/2 cross-row TOCTOU' describe block, store_test.exs:775-940) 8 additional times on 5 fresh seeds never used by TEST-DESIGNER or TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (7001, 314159, 20260818, 555, 8675309) plus 3 unseeded runs -- all 8 runs: `Result: 27 passed`, 0 failures. Captured each run's full debug query log and grepped independently for 'QUERY ERROR': exactly one hit per run, every time, on the identical statement -- `UPDATE ...process_definitions... SET status=$1... WHERE ((p0."id" = $3) AND (p0."status" = 'draft'))` -- i.e. the self-activate UPDATE, precisely the window the telemetry-rendezvous mechanism is designed to force. This is real corroborating evidence at the Postgres-log level, independent of trusting the test's own pass/fail assertions -- the rework genuinely holds, not a lucky pair of prior runs. (3) ALL 9 ACTUAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA RE-READ FROM docs/requirements.yaml (lines 1408-1417, re-counted myself: 9, not the code-designer-reported 8) AND CHECKED AGAINST SHIPPED CODE/TESTS DIRECTLY: AC1 (graph-validation failure writes zero rows, all 3 validator phases) -- lib/letflow/definitions.ex:335-347 create/2's `with` chain calls validate_graph/1, validate_node_attributes/1, validate_edge_conditions/1 in sequence before insert_definition/3 is ever reached; store_test.exs:262-320 has 3 distinct tests, one per phase, each asserting `count_by_name == 0`. AC2 (concurrent identical create) -- store_test.exs:331-353 uses real Task.async against real separate Postgres connections (Sandbox :auto), asserts exactly 1 success + 1 :duplicate_name_version + count==1; code path is a real `ON CONFLICT (name, version) DO NOTHING` (definitions.ex:542-547), not a citation fallback. AC3 (atomic deprecate-then-activate) -- activate_draft/2 (definitions.ex:647-662) runs both UPDATEs inside one Repo.transaction; store_test.exs:402-418 re-reads both rows from Postgres after the call and asserts old=deprecated, new=active, count_active==1. AC4 (idempotent no-op on ACTIVE) -- run_activate_transaction/4's `%ProcessDefinition{status: :active}` branch (definitions.ex:616-617) returns `{:already_active, definition}`, never an error; store_test.exs:427-441 calls activate/2 three times, asserts already_active:false then true/true, never an error. AC5 (all forbidden-transition cells) -- CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR independently confirmed the real table has 9 off-diagonal forbidden cells, not the 4 requirements.yaml's own prose names; store_test.exs:467-590 has 9 distinct named tests (one per cell: DRAFT->DEPRECATED, DRAFT->ARCHIVED, ACTIVE->DRAFT, ACTIVE->ARCHIVED, DEPRECATED->DRAFT, DEPRECATED->ACTIVE, ARCHIVED->DRAFT, ARCHIVED->ACTIVE, ARCHIVED->DEPRECATED), each a real `test` block with its own assertion, not a generic loop -- read each individually, confirmed distinct. AC6 (nil-able service_scope_validator hook, documented in moduledoc) -- activate/2's @spec (definitions.ex:427-433) and activate_opts() type (:106-109) carry the hook as an optional function-or-nil; moduledoc (:39-49) names it explicitly as the SVC-03/REQ-031 integration point; store_test.exs:600-666 has 4 tests covering :ok-proceeds, {:error,_}-aborts-stays-draft, hook-skipped-on-already-active-path, hook-skipped-on-rejected-transition (the latter two use an exploding validator that would raise if wrongly invoked). AC7 (get_active_by_name never falls back to non-active) -- definitions.ex:378-387 queries `status == :active` only, returns {:error, :not_found} on empty result, no fallback branch exists in the code at all; store_test.exs:677-708 tests active-hit, draft-only-miss, and (most rigorously) deprecated-only-miss with an explicit sanity assertion that the deprecated row genuinely exists first. AC8 (stage filter exact-match, combinable) -- where_stage/2 (definitions.ex:593-594) is `d.stage == ^stage`, an exact equality predicate, not ILIKE; store_test.exs:718-754 creates a 'prod' and a 'production' row specifically to catch an accidental substring-match bug, and combines stage+status+name in one call. AC9 (tenant_id always derived, rejects disagreement loudly) -- reject_key/4 (definitions.ex:481-487) checks both atom and string key forms for :tenant_id before tenant_id is even derived, short-circuiting the whole `with` chain with {:error, :tenant_id_not_accepted} on either form; store_test.exs:364-392 has 3 tests: correct derivation matches the real tenant, atom-key rejection, string-key rejection -- all assert `count_by_name == 0`, i.e. loud failure not silent misattribution. Independently confirmed reject_key/4 runs before TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 is even called (definitions.ex:335-337), so a supplied tenant_id can never reach the derivation step let alone the insert. Also independently read TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:102-115) directly: parses the tenant's own schema-name string back into a canonical UUID with no trust in caller-supplied data, matching docs/migration/decisions/0003-ecto-schema-strategy.md's 2026-08-17 addendum exactly (re-read that addendum directly, lines 326-395 -- no contradiction between the shipped mechanism and the decision record). AC6/AC9's doc-content half independently confirmed in the actual moduledoc text (definitions.ex:29-50), matching what definitions_test.exs:166-213's doc-content tests assert against (`service_scope_validator`, `tenant_id_not_accepted`, the literal phrase 'never accepts a `:tenant_id`', `tenant_id_for_schema_name` -- all four strings grep-confirmed present verbatim in the actual moduledoc, not assumed from the test file alone). (4) STALENESS CHECK: docs/requirements.yaml REQ-030 entry (line 1342) still reads `status: in_progress` -- correct, DOC-UPDATER (Step 6) has not run yet, no contradiction. docs/status/requirement_status.yaml's most recent REQ-030 entry (line 2935-2954) is the Step 00 'started' event (2026-08-17T17:40:14Z) -- no premature 'done' event exists anywhere in the file; grepped the full file for REQ-030 and confirmed no stale/duplicate/out-of-order entries.
